tewip.path.markdownDescription: How to run Tewip: leave it as `tewip` when it is installed with `npm install -g tewip-ai`, or give the path to `cli/tewip.ts` (or `dist/cli/tewip.js`) in a checkout.

tewip.checkForUpdates.markdownDescription: Say so when the installed `tewip` is older than the one published. This extension is a thin shell that runs whatever `tewip` is on your PATH, so an old command line gives old answers and nothing else would tell you. Asks `registry.npmjs.org` at most once a day, and only after you run a Tewip command. Turn it off and the check falls back to the minor version this build was written against.
